jobs.name: Daily Content Brief
jobs.message: Check http://pipeline-api:8000/analytics/summary and send me a morning brief: how many videos published this week, average quality score, and one suggestion for today's content topic based on recent performance.
jobs.comment: Enable this after first videos are published. Change schedule to your preferred time.

jobs.name: Weekly Performance Report
jobs.message: Fetch data from http://pipeline-api:8000/analytics/data and http://pipeline-api:8000/analytics/insights. Create a weekly performance report: total videos, platform breakdown, quality scores, AI insights, and recommendations for next week.
jobs.comment: Weekly Monday morning report. Enable after accumulating some video data.

jobs.name: Pipeline Health Check
jobs.message: Check if all services are healthy: GET http://pipeline-api:8000/health and GET http://cliproxy:8317/v1/models. If anything is down, notify me immediately on Telegram.
jobs.comment: Health check every 6 hours. Enable when running in production.
